title: Deemed Service of Notices
description: Notices are deemed sufficiently served if addressed to the business place of the opposite party or the actual place of residence of the complainant

steps.step: Address the notice, in the case of the opposite party, to the place where business or profession is carried on
Address the notice, in the case of the complainant, to the place where such person actually and voluntarily resides
Serve the notice so addressed, which shall be deemed to be sufficiently served

documents: notice required to be served on the opposite party or the complainant
